articleTitle: Research on Multi-modal Wind-solar Coupling Hydrogen Production Intra-day Energy Management Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: To address the issue of unreasonable energy allocation in wind solar hydrogen storage hybrid power generation systems, this paper proposes an energy coordination management strategy to ensure the stability and flexibility of the system under the premise of stable operation of each control unit. By comparing the mixed power output of wind turbine and PV with the load scheduling demand, and taking the rated power of electrolyzer, fuel cell and hydrogen storage tank as the constraints, the system can be smoothly and precisely switched between various operation modes. Finally, time-domain simulation was conducted using Matlab/Simulink software platform, and the simulation re-sults showed that energy can be reasonably allocated, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed energy management strategy.

articleTitle: Effect of multi-energy storage systems on improving the synergy of integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In the context of energy shortage and environmental pollution problems, the integrated energy system is important for achieving energy transition and reducing carbon emissions, but the synergy between different energy systems can affect the operation of the integrated energy system. This paper proposes a method to improve the synergy of the integrated energy system by using multiple energy storage. The synergy evaluation indexes are constructed, which include the economy of integrated energy system operation, the amount of consumed new energy, and the amount of supplied load power. The case analysis shows that the multiple energy storage systems can improve the synergy, the energy utilization efficiency, and the economy of system operation.

articleTitle: Coordinated optimization Method for Distribution Areas Considering User Willingness and Regulation Cost
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Driven by the policy of building a new type of power system, distributed power sources have started to be connected to the low-voltage distribution network in large numbers. The high proportion of distributed Photovoltaic exacerbates the problem of voltage crossing limits in the low-voltage distribution network. However, users' requirements for power quality are getting higher and higher. In order to effectively improve the capacity of distribution station area for new energy consumption and further reduce the impact of distributed power access on distribution network, new customer-side devices such as electric vehicles, distributed energy storage, air conditioning and electric heating have received wide attention in recent years as an important means to effectively realize the benign interaction between demand and supply of power system. In this paper, we propose an inter-station power complementary coordination strategy considering the regulation cost of customer-side devices and the willingness of customers to regulate, including the optimization model of intra-station regulation command decomposition and the optimization model of inter-station complementary coordination, which improves the consumption capacity of distributed power sources and the power quality through the coordination and cooperation between customer-side devices. The optimization model is solved by genetic algorithm, and the effectiveness of the method is verified by example design.

articleTitle: Primary Frequency Regulation Strategy for Combined Wind-storage System Based on Improved Virtual Inertia Integrated Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The increased penetration of wind power causes a decrease in the equivalent rotational inertia of the system and a serious challenge to the system frequency stability. For this reason, this paper proposes a wind-storage cooperative participation in grid primary frequency regulation (PFR) strategy based on the ability of a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) to participate in frequency regulation at different wind speeds, taking DFIG and battery storage system as an example. The fuzzy logic controller is designed considering the wind speed and frequency change rate to achieve a new DFIG virtual inertia integrated control, which uses the limited rotor kinetic energy of the wind turbine to stop the rapid frequency drop in the inertial response phase. According to the state of charge (SOC) of energy storage for adaptive control, as the DFIG exits the PFR, the energy storage system (ESS) gradually churn out powers and maintains the steady-state recovery process of the frequency. Finally, the simulation verification of the wind-storage cooperative frequency regulation strategy shows that the proposed strategy can effectively improve the frequency response characteristics of the system under different wind conditions, realize the reasonable distribution of wind-storage frequency regulation power, and avoid the occurrence of secondary frequency drop (SFD) accidents, and ensure the frequency stability of high proportion of wind power to the grid.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Park Level Integrated Energy System for Hydrogen Production Based on Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Hydrogen production in park level of integrated energy systems (PIES) with utilization of abundant wind and solar resources can effectively improve the economic benefits of the PIES and promote the integration of renewable energy. This study constructs a PIES with an electricity-hydrogen storage structure. The optimization configuration model is established with the system’s life cycle cost as the objective function, under the constraints of power balance and equipment output limit. The model is solved using a mixed-integer linear programming approach. Based on three different scenarios of the output capacity of the hydrogen storage equipment, the configuration of the PIES equipment, cost analysis, and purchase-sale electricity strategies are investigated, respectively. The analysis results demonstrate that the integrated energy system with the electricity-hydrogen storage structure can effectively utilize the peak-shaving and load-filling capabilities of the energy storage devices to meet the real-time energy demands of users. Moreover, by properly combining the electricity-hydrogen storage capacity, the system not only ensures the economic benefits of the PIES but also provides the park operator with more flexible electricity exchange strategies with power grid.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Backstepping Controller with DC Suppression Loop for Flexible Arc Suppression System in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In distribution networks, a single-line-to-ground fault frequently occurs, which poses a risk to the safe operation of power equipment and causes significant property damage. The conventional arc suppression coil serves as a passive compensating device, which is utilized to compensate for the capacitive component of the fault current. However, it lacks the ability to compensate for an active component of the fault current. To address this issue, this paper proposes a cascaded H-bridge inverter based on a backstepping control method with DC suppression. This method aims to fully compensate for the ground-fault current and restrict the faulty phase voltage. The proposed approach effectively mitigates the impact of system parameter perturbations, suppresses the DC component of the injected current, and reliably limits the fault current. Through simulation verification with different fault resistances, the results indicate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Drawing and Application of Distribution Map of Wind Region in Inner Mongolia Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The reference wind speed is one of the important parameters in the design of overhead lines. The line design in West Inner Mongolia is based on the typical meteorological area wind speed values, and cannot effectively guide the wind protection design of overhead lines. The meteorological data of West Inner Mongolia in the past 30 years were counted. The extreme value I-type distribution probability model was adopted to complete the calculation of the maximum wind speed in the 50-year recurrence period of Inner Mongolia Power Grid. Inner Mongolia Power Grid wind region classification standard was proposed, drawing the distribution map of Inner Mongolia Power Grid wind region. On this basis, the basic wind speed value requirements for the design of overhead lines of different voltage levels are given, and the wind speed value recommendations for areas with micro terrain and extreme meteorological disasters are given, which can provide technical support for the design and renovation of wind damage prevention of overhead lines.

articleTitle: Research on Combined Frequency Modulation Strategy of Wind Turbines and Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The wind farm with a storage system can not only improve the active support capacity of the power grid but also enhance the utilization rate of wind power. This, in turn, increases the economic benefits of wind farms while addressing the primary frequency modulation needs of the power grid. This paper proposes a coordinated frequency control strategy for wind-storage systems based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology. Firstly, a VSG mathematical model of wind storage is established, and the frequency modulation characteristics of the VSG of wind storage are analyzed.Secondly, we delve into the VSG frequency control method for energy storage systems using their mathematical model. Through the parallel output of the wind farm and the energy storage system, the proposed control strategy can reduce the capacity demand of the energy storage system and fully utilize the short-term power support capabilities of wind turbines. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Based on Wide Narrow Convolutions Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Power equipment fault diagnosis has been a research and breakthrough issue in the field of power systems in recent years. Effective diagnostic models can significantly improve equipment reliability and stability. Traditional diagnostic methods rely on mathematical algorithms or physical models to make judgments, which require too much experience and manpower. The rise of artificial intelligence, especially deep learning, can fully tap into the value of data and achieve high-precision diagnostic results. This article proposes a neural network model based on wide narrow convolution. Use wide convolution kernels to extract the first layer features of the data at long time scales, and use narrow convolution kernels to extract the first layer features of the data at short time scales. After completing feature extraction, a deep residual convolutional layer is added to further achieve feature extraction. Finally, use two fully connected layers to output the judgment results. Experiments have shown that this scheme has high effectiveness and generalization.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Substation Meter Readings and Dial Information Based on YOLO-E and OCRNet Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Utilizing electric vision imaging technology for identifying instrument readings in substations has significant benefits for monitoring equipment in real-time and enhancing the intelligence level of operations and maintenance. However, the majority of existing instrument image recognition solutions for substations rely on identifying readings through the angle of deflection of a pointer, despite the need for improvements in precision and robustness. These methods ignore data on device status and numerical intervals reflected by the color of the dial, and do not consider device status information. This paper introduces a novel methodology of automatically recognizing instrument readings and dial information in substations. The proposed method consists of two primary steps. Initially, a dial type position detection algorithm based on YOLO-E is proposed, and image calibration is achieved through perspective transformation. Subsequently, a dial segmentation algorithm based on OCRNet is proposed, and accurate recognition of instrument readings and key additional information is achieved through segmentation of scales, pointers, and color bands. The case study demonstrates that, in contrast to other advanced electric vision algorithms, the proposed method improves the accuracy of reading recognition and be effective to detect the corresponding device status, which could serve as a valuable tool for the digital transformation of operation and maintenance in substations.

articleTitle: Reinjection Five Level Current Source Converters for Individual Parallel-bridge Power Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Reinjection Multilevel Current Source Converters are high-power converters that combine harmonic reinjection, soft switching, and multilevel technology to ensure improved performance in terms of capacity, efficiency, and control flexibility. However, achieving power decoupling control often requires the use of a double parallel-bridge structure, which significantly increases costs and reduces competitiveness. This paper investigates a reinjection five level current source converter (RFCSC) for individual parallel-bridge power decoupling. This topology introduces a degree of freedom (duty cycle) by connecting a diode in parallel to the branch inductor of the reinjected bridge, enabling individual parallel-bridge power decoupling control. Additionally, the new topology has been verified using a simulation platform, and the simulation results demonstrate a comprehensive investigation of the converter.

articleTitle: An Improved Bidirectional Gate Recurrent Unit Combined with Smoothing Filter Algorithm for State of Energy Estimation of Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The accurate estimation of state of energy (SOE) is the key to the rational energy distribution of lithium-ion battery based energy storage equipment. This paper proposes an improved bidirectional gate recursive element combined with a time-varying bounded layer based smooth variable structure filtering algorithm. First, based on the solid temporal nature of the estimated parameters, a BiGRU neural network structure is constructed to strengthen further the influence of past and future information on the current estimates. Then, based on the traditional variable structure filtering, a time-varying bounded layer smoothing mechanism with saturation restriction (TS-VBL) is proposed to smooth the output of BiGRU to obtain a more accurate estimate. Finally, the test was conducted under 15℃ hybrid pulse power characterization (HPPC) and 35℃ Beijing bus dynamic stress test (BBDST). Compared with other algorithms, the BiGRU-TSVSF algorithm has a minor maximum estimation error of 0.00495 and 0.00722, respectively. The experimental results show that the algorithm has high precision and robustness and is of great value to the energy storage research of energy storage equipment.

articleTitle: Short-term wind power prediction based on EVMD-SSA-LSSVM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In order to obtain a prediction model with high prediction accuracy, this paper proposes a short-term wind power prediction method based on a combination of variational modal decomposition and least squares support vector machines. The method uses the signal energy principle to improve the variational modal decomposition method, so as to accurately obtain the number of modal decompositions and pre-process the wind field historical data; the parameters of the least squares support vector machine are optimized using the sparrow search algorithm to further improve the prediction accuracy of the vector machine model. The pre-processed historical data are brought into the prediction model for short-term wind power prediction, and the prediction accuracy of different models is evaluated using the evaluation indexes in the wind power prediction technology regulations. Through simulation verification and comparative analysis, it is proved that the proposed prediction method has high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A Precise Prediction Model Tool for Distribution Network Reliability Indicators Based on Big Data and Multi method Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy in predicting the efficiency indicators of intelligent distribution networks, a precise prediction model tool for the efficiency indicators of intelligent distribution networks is proposed. On the basis of determining the evaluation of the efficiency indicators of the intelligent distribution network, expert methods and interpretive structural models are first used to mine the internal and external multiple information, clarify the hierarchy of each information's impact on the indicators, and on this basis, comprehensively identify the influencing factors of each indicator as much as possible. Then, using the partial least squares method - variable projection importance analysis method, the VIP value of the influencing factors is calculated to accurately measure the importance of their impact on the target variable (studied indicator value), achieving dimensionality reduction of the influencing factors. Next, establish a benefit simulation model based on system dynamics model, set boundary conditions, conduct variable analysis, simulate and calculate the predicted values of each indicator, and verify the accuracy of the results using historical big data. After the correctness and accuracy of the model are verified, this tool is used to predict reliability indicators for future years.

articleTitle: An improved robust function correction-adaptive extended kalman filtering algorithm for SOC estimation of lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: State of Charge (SOC) is one of the key indicators for evaluating the state of electric vehicles. In order to cope with the uncertainty of random noise in nonlinear systems, an improved robust function correction-adaptive extended Kalman filtering (RFC-AEKF) algorithm is proposed for SOC prediction. Using FFRLS method to verify the Dual Polarization model established in this paper. The robust function is an abstract method that describes system state noise and observation noise, and performs real-time correction, combined with adaptive methods to estimate SOC. The experimental results show that the proposed RFC-AEKF algorithm has the smallest mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) compared to other algorithms. Under the Beijing bus dynamic stress test (BJDST) conditions, the MAE and RMSE of the RFC-AEKF are 0.354% and 0.658%, respectively, indicating that the RFC-AEKF algorithm can improve SOC estimation accuracy and enhance robustness.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Low-frequency AC Transmission on the Performance of Key Transmission and Transformation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Flexible low-frequency AC transmission technology is a new AC transmission technology based on voltage source cross-exchanger. Because it takes into account the advantages of power frequency AC transmission and flexible HVDC transmission, it is a useful supplement to AC and HVDC transmission technology. On the basis of a detailed introduction to the structure of the flexible low-frequency AC transmission system, the performance impact of flexible low-frequency AC transmission on key transmission and transformation equipment such as transformers was analyzed. This analysis can provide reference for the selection and design of the main equipment of the flexible low-frequency AC transmission system.

Author Keywords: key power transmission and transformation equipment

articleTitle: Microgrid Reliability Assessment Considering Frequency Response Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In response to the challenges posed by the uncertainty characteristics of low inertia in isolated microgrids, which may undergo frequency instability in the event of power disturbance. This paper presents a novel reliability assessment method for microgrids considering the frequency response characteristics. By leveraging the concept of under-frequency load shedding, the load shedding strategy for isolated microgrids during renewable energy output fluctuations is studied, considering both the frequency nadir of the microgrid following active power deficit and ramping capability of the distributed power source. The proposed load shed strategy is fused into a sequential Monte Carlo method to evaluate reliability indices. The proposed algorithm is applied to evaluate a microgrid system modified from IEEE RBTS Bus6 F4 feeder, and the frequency response influences on index estimations are investigated. The results show the proposed method improves the power supply reliability of the microgrid.

articleTitle: Improved Strategy for Initial Point Generation of Intelligent Algorithm for Battery Operation Optimization in Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed renewable energy and energy storage, microgrids have emerged as a new energy system model. To better utilize peak-valley electricity prices or absorb renewable energy, it is necessary to optimize the operation of batteries in the system. This usually involves constructing a mathematical model of the system and applying optimization algorithms. Among various types of optimization algorithms, intelligent optimization algorithms are widely used due to their superior adaptability to models. However, for energy storage batteries, due to their complex constraint conditions, it is often challenging to ensure that intelligent optimization algorithms can converge quickly or find feasible regions. Therefore, considering the modelling characteristics of the constraints of energy storage batteries, this paper proposes an initial point generation strategy based on a divide-and-conquer approach. This strategy ensures that all initial points of the intelligent optimization algorithm meet the battery model constraints and exhibit excellent randomness and diversity. Subsequent case tests show that, compared with intelligent optimization algorithms not adopting this strategy, those using this strategy converge faster and deliver better optimization results.

articleTitle: Coordinated Planning of Distributed Photovoltaic Stations and Coal-Replacement-Electricity Devices in Electrical Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Undervoltage problem exists in low-voltage distribution networks because of vast accessed high-power coal-replacement-electricity devices. This problem can be solved by the coordinated planning of distributed photovoltaic stations and the coal-replacement-electricity devices. The optimal configuration, which is used to solve the undervoltage problem, is established with the minimum voltage deviation of the grid node and the minimum capacity of the distributed photovoltaic stations. And the location and capacity of the photovoltaic system are solved by the genetic algorithm under the established coordinated planning model. The simulation results show that the photovoltaic absorptive capacity of low-voltage distribution network can be effectively promoted under the existing low-voltage distribution network structure by our proposed method.

articleTitle: Parameter identification of DFIG model based on HHT marginal spectrum
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Due to the randomness and volatility of the environment where the wind turbine is generated, the model parameters of the wind turbine are in a state of fluctuation, high precision parameter identification of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) is beneficial to a more thorough understanding of the operating state of the generator and the impact of wind turbines on the power grid. A method based on Hilbert-Huang Transformation (HHT) marginal spectrum is proposed to identify the electrical parameters of DFIG, where the objective function related to parameter identification is improved, and the characteristics of different frequency signals contained in the output signals are decoupled. The simulation results show that proposed method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on PV Maximum Power Tracking Based on IMA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) cannot be guaranteed under the partial shading of photovoltaic (PV) module based on traditional methods, this paper proposes to apply the Improved Mayfly Algorithm (IMA) to the MPPT control. By limiting the maximum speed and minimum speed of mayfly, it is avoided that the mayfly flies out of the problem space due to the excessive initial speed. In the iterative process of the algorithm, the mayfly walk coefficient is gradually reduced, and the oscillation of the algorithm at the Maximum Power Point (MPP) is reduced. The individuals with "gene mutation" are added to the offspring of the mayfly, which avoid local optimum. Through comparative analyses among IMA, Incremental Conductance (INC) and Improved Particle Swarm Optimization (IPSO), the simulation results the effectiveness of the IMA under typical working conditions.

articleTitle: Large-scale energy storage system structure design and Thermal Flow Field Optimization-A case study
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Batteries are the most important components of an energy storage system. However, the charging and discharging processes will cause the battery cells to generate a lot of heat, which leads to an increase in the temperature of the battery cells. Traditional built-in cooling fans can dissipate heat to a certain extent, but they are prone to temperature buildup and cause excessive internal temperature differences. How to dissipate heat from lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) in large-scale energy storage systems is a focus of current research. Therefore, in this paper, an internal circulation system is proposed to change the heat flow field distribution inside the energy storage cabinet from the perspective of structural optimization in order to improve the heat transfer. The evaluation results show that the maximum temperature and the maximum temperature difference inside the energy storage system are significantly reduced with the use of internal circulation.

articleTitle: Design Optimisation of a Magnetic Coupler for Wireless Power Transfer for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The efficiency of a wireless power transfer (WPT) system depends on the coupling coefficient of the coupling coil, which is directly affected by the coil winding method. In order to improve the coupling coefficient of the coupling coil, a design optimization method for rectangular pad winding is proposed. The principle of the WPT system and the theory of the coil coupling coefficient are first analysed, then a three-dimensional model is built in ANSYS/Maxwell and the optimal design is carried out in terms of turn-to-turn distance, the number of coil turns, coil start position and coil size. The experimental results show that the optimized design method proposed in this paper can maintain high misalignment tolerance and coupling coefficient while reducing the amount of litz wire used.

articleTitle: Inertia and Damping Adaptive Control Based on Bifurcation Analysis and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: To obtain the best interval of the virtual inertia and damping of the virtual synchronous generator (VSG), the bifurcation theory is employed in this paper to overcome the conservative of the traditional root locus method. In addition, to obtain the optimal inertia and damping value in real time, this paper applies the adaptive radial basis function neural network to the parameter control of the VSG. Finally, the correctness of the inertia and damping range selection based on the bifurcation analysis and the excellent characteristics of the control strategy, such as small frequency overshoot and short response time, are verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A Review of Parameterization Methods for the Electrochemical Model of Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the development of technology, clean energy, energy transition, and sustainable development have become the trend of current society. Lithium-ion batteries are widely applied because of their significant advantages as the energy storage components for electric vehicle (EV), power system, consumer electronic products, etc. An accurate battery model is of great importance to battery management and state estimation. The precision of a battery model critically hinges on the accuracy of its parameters. This paper summarizes the parameterization method of electrochemical models, parameter measurement and parameter identification, analyses their advantages and drawbacks, and put forward future research directions. The discussion and analysis presented in this work can serve as a valuable reference for parameterizing battery models.

articleTitle: Attention-based convolutional neural network-long short-term memory network wind power forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: To enhance the precision of wind power forecasting, this study proposes an attention-based convolutional neural network-long short-term memory (AT-CNN-LSTM) prediction model. The model is designed to address the intermittent and sequential characteristics of wind power data. Initially, a CNN is employed to extract multidimensional features from the dynamic changes observed in wind power data. Subsequently, the extracted feature vectors are transformed into a sequential format and utilized as input for the LSTM network. To optimize the model, an attention mechanism is incorporated, assigning varying weights to the hidden layers of the LSTM network. This approach enhances the influence of crucial information, thereby improving wind power prediction. Experimental results conducted on wind power data obtained from a local wind farm demonstrate that the proposed model surpasses both LSTM and CNN-LSTM models in terms of prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Resilience Enhancement Strategies Based on Fault Repair Schemes in Distribution Network Considering Uncertainty of Traffic Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The occurrence of extreme disasters will lead to multi-point faults in the distribution network. A reasonable repair plan can quickly restore power supply and minimize losses to enhance distribution network resilience. The repair scheduling strategy is affected by both the transportation network and the distribution network. In view of this, a repair scheduling strategy considering the uncertainty of road capacity is proposed. Firstly, the repair scheduling strategy framework based on the traffic-distribution network coupling is proposed. Secondly, the road resistance function is used to describe the travel time. The probability distribution of road saturation is obtained based on the Gaussian mixture model(GMM), and the typical scenario of the road network is obtained by Monte Carlo simulation(MCS) and synchronous back reduction(SBR). Then, a collaborative optimization model of repair scheduling and distribution network reconfiguration is established. Finally, the proposed method is verified at the IEEE33 system. The results show that the proposed repair scheduling strategy can improve the load recovery efficiency and verify the rationality of the repair strategy.

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Combined Heat Pipe and Water Cooling for Battery Pack Cooling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Battery thermal management is becoming more and more important with the rapid development of new energy vehicles. This paper presents a novel cooling structure for cylindrical power batteries, which cools the battery with heat pipes and uses liquid cooling to dissipate heat from the heat pipes. Firstly, the structure is parameterized and the numerical model of the battery pack is established based on different parameters. After that, the simulation is carried out using the commercial CFD software FLUENT. The results of the study show that the structure is effective in controlling the temperature of the battery within a suitable temperature range. As the flow rate increases, the battery temperature will gradually decrease, but when the flow rate reaches a certain value, the heat transfer of the cooling water will dominate, and the flow rate will gradually become less influential on the battery temperature. Adjusting the structural parameters will change the heat storage capacity of the structure and improve heat dissipation. When the construction parameter x is set to 25 mm, the best heat dissipation is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Grounding Grid Based on WDA-uVOL
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Substation grounding grid corrosion is a potential safety hazard in substations. At present, there is a lack of practical methods for grounding grid corrosion diagnosis. In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of corrosion diagnosis of substation grounding grid, this paper proposes a Waveform Difference Algorithm under Vertical Observation Line (WDA-uVOL) based on Electromagnetic Field Theory (EFT) to diagnose the corrosion conductor of grounding grid. This method first selects the surface magnetic induction intensity waveform diagram measured when the observation line is perpendicular to the excitation source and the corrosion state and the non-corrosion state, and calculates the difference between the two to determine the horizontal range (X-axis). Then, the surface magnetic induction intensity waveforms of the corrosion state and the non-corrosion state measured when the observation line is horizontal to the excitation source are selected, and the difference between the two is obtained to determine the position range of the corroded conductor under the horizontal range (Y-axis). Finally, the horizontal range (X-axis) and the vertical range (Y-axis) are combined to obtain the specific corrosion conductor position. The test shows that the position of the corroded conductor set in this experiment is consistent with the position of the corroded conductor obtained by the algorithm, which indicates the accuracy of the method to diagnose the corroded conductor.

articleTitle: CLLLC resonant converter compound control for optical storage system
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Energy storage is one of the ways to absorb renewable energy and reduce its fluctuation. CLLLC resonant converter is used in optical power generation energy storage system in this paper. In this paper, the voltage-current double-loop control strategy of the battery current inner ring is adopted, and the compound control combining frequency conversion control and phase shift control is adopted to enable the converter to provide channels for charging and discharging energy storage batteries. Within the entire input range, the switch tubes can achieve both zero voltage switching (ZVS) and zero current switching (ZCS). This paper analyzed the working state and characteristics of the converter under two control schemes. Finally, using MATLAB/ Simulink simulation platform to verify the accuracy of theoretical analysis and the validity of the control method.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Zinc-iron Liquid Flow Battery Based on Flow Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Zinc-iron liquid flow batteries have high open-circuit voltage under alkaline conditions and can be cyclically charged and discharged for a long time under high current density, it has good application prospects in the field of distributed energy storage. The magnitude of the electrolyte flow rate of a zinc-iron liquid flow battery greatly influences the charging and discharging characteristics of the battery, and the battery's energy efficiency changes significantly with the change in flow rate. In this paper, the effect of electrolyte flow rate on battery capacity and energy efficiency is experimentally investigated under the conditions of circulating pump output for different engineering applications. The experimental method verifies that the electrolyte flow rate is an important factor affecting the energy efficiency of the battery. In this paper, the experimental and energy efficiency calculations of the charge/discharge characteristics of a single cell, a single stack battery, and a 200 kW overall energy storage module are analyzed, and the optimal pump output and flow rate are optimized and compared step by step. The experimental operation results show that the overall energy efficiency of the stack remains good under the conditions of 42-46 m3/h. However, along with the increase in the number of charge and discharge cycles and the increase in the number of stacks, the stability of the single stack battery affects the battery capacity and charge and discharge characteristics of the whole battery module.

articleTitle: Development of cable impedance spectrum measurement system based on symmetrical balanced bridge
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The Line Resonance Analysis (LIRA) method is an emerging and robust technique for cable fault detection. The application basis of this method is obtaining the impedance spectrum of the cable. In this study, the circuit structure for impedance measurement using the traditional "half-bridge method" was improved, enabling impedance measurement in a wide frequency range from 100kHz to 10MHz. The overall system comprises a control system with STM32F103RCT6 as the core, an excitation signal system, a core measurement system utilizing a two-channel symmetrical automatic balance bridge, and a human-machine interface. The experimental results showed that the innovative design of the two-channel symmetrical automatic balance bridge compensated for the amplitude and phase of the measured signals, resulting in stable output of the measured signal ratios with a deviation not exceeding 0.2%. Conducting laboratory tests using self-developed equipment. The measurement error of resistance was controlled within 0.7%. The obtained cable impedance spectrum resonant periods and magnitudes met the accuracy requirements for LIRA, with a cable fault positioning error of not exceeding 0.37%.

articleTitle: Primary frequency control of flywheel energy storage assisted wind farms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With that increase in new energy penetration, that frequency variable problem is being exacerbated. In a regional electrical network with a certain wind electricity penetration rate, sag containment is adopted by that wind turbo-charger when that rated wind velocity is falling, and a hybrid containment consisting of sag containment combined with pitch containment is employed when that rated wind velocity is exceeded. Additionally, virtual inertia containment is implemented by that flywheel energy storage for primary frequency harmonise when that wind turbine frequency outweigh that frequency adjustment deadband zone. That wind turbine frequency characteristics of that flywheel energy storage-assisted wind turbines are analyzed, that wind turbines frequency harmonise measures are designed, and that feasibility of that harmonise measures is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: A Method for Achieving Decoupling and Interoperability of Edge-Terminal Interaction in Distribution Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: This paper elaborates on the "Cloud-Communication-Edge-Terminal" distribution Internet of Things system with Distribution Transformer Supervisory Terminal Unit (TTU) in the substation area as the core, and discusses the achievements of low-voltage distribution networks in Zhejiang. And in response to the problem of uncoupling and interconnecting applications between the edge and Terminal interactions of the distribution Internet of Things, a standardized topology recognition method for physical features and business data interaction content is proposed, and verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Research on EV Schedulable Capability Prediction Method Based on Data-model Hybrid Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: As the number of EV continues to increase, it is increasingly important to stimulate the release of schedulable resources on the demand side, let it participate in the optimal regulation of power system. Aiming at the problem of EV cluster schedulable capability prediction, this paper proposes a data-model hybrid driven EV schedulable capability calculation method. Firstly, the EV cluster is aggregated into GES devices by Minkowski summation method. Then, Bi-LSTM is used to mine the parameters of GES equipment and predict them. Finally, the prediction results of GES equipment parameters are put into the EV schedulable capability model. The simulation results show that Bi-LSTM can better mine the rules of time series data and accurately predict the parameters of GES model. The proposed method can aggregate EV clusters into GES devices, reduce the model dimension, and realize the quantification of schedulable capability of EV clusters.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Energy Storage in Microgrid Considering the Reliability of Power Supply for Critical Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: For a county power grid structure is weak, power supply reliability is low, and a certain capacity of critical loads is connected. Based on the main network of the region, this paper plans to use the new energy station that has been put into operation, and build a critical load microgrid by optimizing the configuration of energy storage system (ESS), so as to improve the reliability of the power supply of critical loads and the utilization rate of the new energy station. With the power supply reliability of the microgrid island running system as the constraint condition, and the minimum annual investment cost of the energy storage system and the operating cost of the microgrid as the objective function, the economic model of energy storage capacity optimization allocation of the microgrid with critical loads is established. By using simulated annealing particle swarm optimization (SAPSO) algorithm, the optimal allocation of ESS capacity in a critical load microgrid under different reliability constraints is quantitatively analyzed. The results show that the critical load microgrid based on the existing wind power and photovoltaic can improve the power supply reliability of the critical load by increasing ESS capacity, and also increase the utilization rate of new energy.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Alternative Methods for Areva Valve Based Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The converter station of Areva technology has been in operation for many years, and its valve based electronic equipment is close to the design life of the equipment, facing problems such as lack of spare parts and lack of after-sales service. However, the internal characteristics of the converter valve of Areva Technology roadmap are always a "black box" problem externally. If it is in this situation for a long time, it may affect the normal operation and maintenance of the equipment, so it is urgent to simulate and replace it. Firstly, the working principle of ultra-high voltage converter valves and the functions of valve based electronic devices are analyzed. Then, a dynamic analysis adaptive simulation method for valve based electronic device simulation is proposed, and the unique serial communication protocol between AREVA valve based electronic devices and gate units is analyzed. Through in-depth research and experimental verification, the AREVA unique serial communication protocol is fully mastered, Finally, a layered modular hardware architecture design scheme for valve based electronic equipment is proposed, and prototype development is completed. The replacement prototype adopts hardware redundancy design, supporting seamless switching of redundant systems and online replacement of faulty boards. The experimental results indicate that the alternative prototype can effectively simulate and replace the triggering and monitoring functions of AREVA thyristor level circuits.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion Battery SOC Estimation by Integrating Electrochemical Model with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The development of new energy vehicles has led to a surge in interest in lithium-ion batteries. In order to ensure the safe and efficient use of these batteries, an accurate assessment of the State of Charge (SOC) is essential for battery management systems. Data-driven estimation methods provide a new approach for SOC estimation, but they always neglect the internal state information of the battery. To overcome this limitation, the paper proposes a method to estimate the SOC of lithium-ion batteries. This method integrates an electrochemical model with deep learning. Firstly, an electrochemical simplified model, the Single Particle Model (SPM), is introduced to obtain internal battery information. Secondly, we propose a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network as a data-driven model. The input current, temperature, terminal voltage of the SPM and the deviation between the terminal voltage and the experimental data are included in the input vector of the neural network. The output vector represents the state of charge determined by the ampere-hour integral method. Finally, the neural network was trained using data collected from the DST test at 25°C, and data collected from the US06 and FUDS tests were selected to evaluate the predictive performance of the neural network. Simulation results demonstrate that the SOC estimation method, which integrates the electrochemical model with deep learning, achieves high prediction accuracy with an error of less than 2% under different driving cycles. This paper serves as a reference for research on methods of estimating SOC in lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Design of a piezoelectric-electromagnetic hybrid energy harvester and power collection for railway monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In order to enhance the efficiency of vibration energy harvesting from the railway, a piezoelectric-electromagnetic hybrid energy harvester (P-EHEH) is proposed and the power collection system is studied to couple with the harvester outputs. Both the piezoelectric transducer and the magnetic transducer are composed in the P-EHEH to harvest the vibration energy of the railway when the base structure is excited by the trains passing through. The P-EHEH has been accurately modeled and experimentally verified. The results show that at the excitation displacement amplitude of 4 mm @20 Hz, the maximum output power reaches 280 mW. When the P-EHEH charges a capacitor of 470 μF, the maximum voltage of the capacitor is augmented by 45% (from 9 V to 13 V) compared with a single electromagnetic energy harvester (EEH), and the charging time is reduced by 47% (from 75 s to 40 s) compared with a piezoelectric energy harvester (PEH). It is concluded that the P-EHEH proposed in this paper can effectively harvest the vibration energy of the railway and provide a power supply for monitoring devices in the wireless sensing system.

articleTitle: A Steel Wire Rope Defect Detection Method for Gantry Crane in Gravity Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Gravity energy storage is a sustainable energy storage technology widely used in power systems and the energy industry. Steel wire ropes are critical components of gravity energy storage systems, and their safety and reliability are vital for the operation of the energy storage system. In recent years, significant progress has been made in defect detection in the field of deep learning-based object detection methods. This study presents an enhanced YOLOv7 model-based approach for wire rope defect detection. Firstly, this paper applies mosaic data augmentation to a portion of the image data, followed by mixup data augmentation on a subset of the mosaic-augmented data, to strengthen the resilience and generalizability of the enhanced model. Additionally, this paper adopts feature-level cascaded reuse in the backbone of the YOLOv7 model to address the issue of information loss from lower-level networks to higher-level networks. Experimental results demonstrate that in contrast to the original YOLOv7 model, the enhanced model achieves a 4.3% increase in mAP@0.5 and improves the detection of small defects in steel wire ropes.

articleTitle: AC Fault Ride-through Control Strategy and Fault Characteristics Analysis of AC / DC System Based on MMC-MTDC
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In the Multi-Terminal Direct Current based on Modular Multilevel Converter ( MMC-MTDC ) system, the fault characteristics become more complex when an AC fault occurs in the receiving end system connected to the multi-terminal DC transmission system. When a fault occurs on the AC side of converter station 4, the grid-connected point voltage drops, and the input and output power of the converter station are out of balance. This unbalanced power causes fluctuations in the DC voltage of the MMC-MTDC system, resulting in overvoltage in the DC system. So, to ensure the safe and stable operation of the system, a coordinated control strategy under various combinations of reactive power priority, voltage droop, suppression of negative sequence combined with energy dissipation resistance is proposed to maintain DC voltage stability, Furthermore, the fault characteristics and influencing factors under different types of faults are further discussed. To prove the availability of the coordinated control strategy, symmetric and asymmetric faults are considered. When asymmetric faults occur, the negative sequence component fed into the AC side is reduced by suppressing the negative sequence current; when a three-phase short-circuit fault occurs, the DC side voltage exceeds 1.05 p.u., at this time, the energy dissipation resistor is activated to consume the surplus power of the system, so that the DC voltage is controlled within the range of 1.0 ~ 1.05 p.u.. In addition, based on the voltage droop control strategy, by adjusting the active power transmitted by the MMC, the surplus power of the DC line can be absorbed, and the MMC can be controlled to restore power balance as soon as possible during the fault. Finally, the effectiveness of the AC fault ride-through scheme is verified by RTDS simulation experiments, and the consistency between the fault characteristics and the theoretical analysis conclusions under this control scheme is confirmed.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of the Slow Charging Infrastructure Capacity for Urban Areas with Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The unordered charging of electric vehicles (EVs) can lead to a substantial surge of peak loads, which will further require an efficient charging infrastructure roll-out. In this study, we face the problem known as capacity optimization of residential distribution transformers and offer a heuristic method to plan a cost-effective infrastructure for the EVs slow-charging into urban contexts. Therefore, this paper proposed three type of charging scheduling method for EVs in urban distribution network to shift load demand from peak period to valley period, which includes timed charging, ordered charging, Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) charging. Two constraints were mainly considered for the EVs slow-charging, that includes charging scheduling method and the scale of urban distribution network. Furthermore, Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) was used to simulate the randomness of EVs. The results have shed light on both the charging scheduling method selection for governments and the capacity enlargement for different scale of urban distribution network.

articleTitle: SOC Online Estimation Error Correction Algorithm Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Particle Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the popularization of new energy vehicles and renewable energy, accurate prediction of battery state of charge (SOC) is crucial for vehicle performance and safety. This article proposes an error correction method for SOC online estimation by using particle swarm optimization particle filtering method and improving on traditional algorithms. Through experimental verification, this method outperforms traditional methods in terms of SOC estimation accuracy, convergence speed, and computational efficiency. The experimental results show that the particle filter algorithm based on particle swarm optimization outperforms traditional methods in terms of average absolute error, root mean square error, and maximum error. Meanwhile, this method can quickly obtain accurate SOC estimation results and has higher computational efficiency. Therefore, this algorithm is of great significance for the performance optimization and safety control of electric vehicles, providing new ideas for further research in the field of SOC estimation.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Forgetting Factor Recursive Least Squares-Extended Kalman Filter Algorithm for Energy State Estimation of Decommissioned Power Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problem of online estimation of the state of energy (SOE) for decommissioned power lithium-ion batteries, an estimation method based on an adaptive forgetting factor recursive least squares-extended Kalman filter (AFFRLS-EKF) algorithm is proposed. The AFFRLS-EKF algorithm uses fuzzy logic to add a forgetting factor based on the traditional recursive least squares algorithm so that the online parameter identification can reflect the model parameters in a more real-time manner. A second-order RC equivalent circuit model is constructed based on the dynamic characteristics of decommissioned power lithium-ion batteries, which can more accurately represent the electrochemical characteristics of the batteries. The proposed algorithms MAE, MAPE, RMSE, and ME are improved by 1.15%, 3.698%, 1.027%, and 1.64% respectively. The estimation accuracy and robustness of the algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Network-side voltage sag source location method based on limited monitoring point data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The probability of voltage sag caused by transient faults is high and the daily working condition transient line is unknown. In order to find and locate the voltage sag in time, a method of locating the voltage sag source on the network side based on limited monitoring point data is proposed. This method is mainly used to locate the voltage sag caused by transient faults. Based on the method of voltage sag source location at two monitoring points, the voltage estimate of monitoring points is obtained by the possible fault distance, and the sag source is precisely located by analyzing the error between the voltage estimate and the actual value of monitoring points. Finally, the IEEE-9 node standard test system is used for simulation, and the simulation shows the practicability and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-timescale Coordinated Operation Optimization of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Energy and environmental issues have made the integrated energy system (IES) a research focus. The IES promotes the complementary operation of the electric energy flow (EEF) and the thermal energy flow (TEF). However, the timescale differences between two energy flows make the IES operation optimization difficult. To handle the problem, this study proposes a multi-timescale coordinated operation optimization method for electricity-heat coupled IESs. The proposed method defines decision variables and constraints at different timescales to characterize the operation characteristics of EEF and TEF. The coordinated optimization mechanisms are established between two energy flows based on the energy coupling relationship. The optimization method can not only ensure the real-time power balance of EEF, but also meet the cold/heat energy demands over a long-time interval. Simulation results show that the proposed method reduces the operation cost by 7.7% compared to a tradition operation strategy. Furthermore, the proposed method provides a more effective way than the single timescale optimization method to deal with the volatility of renewable generation and electric load.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Environmental Economic Dispatch Based on Fractional-order Multi-objective Differential Evolution Algorithm Subtitle as needed
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Economic dispatch can ensure the safe and economic operation of the power system, which is a low-cost and highly efficient dispatch method. Eco-economic dispatch of renewable energy is a highly effective measure to meet the current demand for energy savings and emission reduction and is in line with the concept of protecting the environment as well as the rational use of new energy sources. In this paper, photovoltaic power generation, wind power, thermal power generation, and small hydro power plants in the river are considered in the multi-objective environmental and economic dispatch model, and a fractional order-based differential evolution algorithm is designed for the model to be investigated and solved. The experimental results are compared with the original multiobjective differential evolutionary algorithm, and the optimal Pareto front and Hypervolume Indicator measurements of the two algorithms are compared with the results of the computational cases, proving that the algorithm proposed in this paper has a good performance.

articleTitle: HAST test of electrical connectors for electronic control systems of new energy vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Electrical connector is one of the key components in the electronic control system of new energy vehicles, and its reliability is very important to the normal operation of the whole electronic control system. In order to quickly evaluate the reliability of the electrical connector, this paper takes the contact resistance as the key performance parameter, selects the temperature and humidity as the comprehensive acceleration stress, designs the HAST test, and quickly obtains the degradation data of the electrical connector at three stress levels. Based on the Wiener process degradation model and the Peck acceleration model, the reliability modeling is carried out, and the optimization algorithm is used to solve the model parameters and obtain the reliability function of the electrical connector. The HAST test of XCE33T41K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> electrical connector was carried out, and the reliability evaluation of the electrical connector was carried out based on the data obtained from the actual test. The results show that the proposed method is effective, especially compared with the traditional hygrothermal accelerated life test, which can effectively shorten the test time.

articleTitle: Analysis of AC Receiving-end Fault Characteristics under MMC-MTDC Multi-combination Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The high voltage direct current transmission system based on modular multilevel converter is connected to the AC system, and the AC fault of the receiving end system will produce new fault characteristics. When an AC fault occurs in the receiving end system, the voltage of the AC system drops, the current rises rapidly, the active power transmission path is blocked, the unbalanced power of the DC line is accumulated, and the DC voltage rises. Therefore, a four-terminal loop network model of flexible DC system is built, and the control strategy of unloading resistance combined with modular multilevel converter is adopted to realize AC fault ride-through. The fault characteristics under the influence of the topology of the ring network system and the AC low voltage ride through strategy are studied. The influence of transition resistance and fault location on short-circuit current under the coordinated control strategy is further analyzed. And the phase current difference between the two sides of the fault point. Finally, the effectiveness of the AC fault ride through scheme is verified by (Real Time Digital Simulator) RTDS simulation, and the consistency between the fault characteristics and the theoretical analysis is confirmed.

articleTitle: Study on Pollution Accumulation Characteristics of Composite Insulators in Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Composite insulator is an important part of transmission line. The stable operation of composite insulators is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of power system. The pollution accumulation of composite insulators is a prerequisite for the occurrence of pollution flashover, so it is of great significance to study the pollution accumulation characteristics of composite insulators. In this paper, the pollution accumulation process of composite insulators is simulated, and the influence of wind direction, particle size and pollution concentration on the pollution accumulation of composite insulators is studied.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling for Multi-energy System Considering Coupling of Molten Medium Hydrogen Production and Pipeline Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Existing hydrogen production technologies always have weakness of large carbon emission, and there are still many research gaps in coupling with multi-energy flow. To this end, this paper proposes an optimal scheduling model for multi-energy system (MES) considering coupling of molten medium hydrogen production (mmH2P) and pipeline energy storage (PES). The mmH2P is introduced into MES to achieve the in-situ green conversion of gas and the zero-carbon-emission hydrogen production while obtaining solid carbon. Further, a Refined PtG-mmH2P mode is proposed combining mmH2P, power-to-gas and hydrogen storage. Besides, the PES due to different transmission inertia of energy flows is considered, and its coupling coordination promotion with Refined PtG-mmH2P is further analyzed. Case study proves that the proposed scheduling model of MES can achieve the win-win of economy, low carbon and high renewable energy consumption rate.

articleTitle: Maximum Value Calculation and Linear Approximation of DC Fault Current of a Single MMC Before Blocking
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The calculation of the DC fault current of a single MMC before blocking is of great significance for practical engineering. For example, the maximum value calculation of the DC fault current before blocking is important for the selection of the inductance of the smoothing reactor. Therefore, this paper mainly studies the calculation of the DC fault current of a single MMC before blocking. Firstly, the analytical expression of the DC fault current before blocking is derived. Secondly, the approximate value of the maximum DC fault current before blocking is obtained by merging and simplifying the expression. Compared with the approximate value calculated by an existing method, it highlights that the maximum value calculation before blocking in this paper is more reasonable. Finally, the feasibility of linear approximation of the DC fault current before blocking is qualitatively analyzed, and the linear approximation analytic expression of the DC fault current is given based on the Taylor formula. By analyzing the error of the linear approximation calculation, its applicability is discussed with 5% and 10% as examples. The feasibility and correctness of the linear approximation calculation are verified by building an electromagnetic transient simulation model in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Decentralized Transmission Network Expansion Planning Considering Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Decarbonization is a trend in the future development of new power systems. At the planning level, simulating the annual carbon trading volume plays a significant role in achieving a low-carbon economy in the future power grid operation. Considering the high interconnectedness of the grid, this paper proposes a decentralized transmission network planning model that takes carbon trading into account. Firstly, a carbon trading mechanism model based on the benchmark method is established. Then, following the idea of the Analytical Target Cascading algorithm, the planning model is decoupled into independent sub-models using the interconnection power of the tie lines as coupling variables. Finally, the improved 48-bus system is simulated to verify the proposed model. The results indicate that decentralized optimization can achieve comparable performance to centralized optimization within an acceptable margin of error. Additionally, it enables synergistic optimization of both low-carbon and economic aspects.

articleTitle: Optimization Configuration Method for Capacity of Photovoltaic Energy Storage System in Urban Rail Transit Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the continuous development of urban rail transit and the increasing demand for energy, photovoltaic energy storage systems play an important role in urban rail transit. This article proposes a demand responsive photovoltaic energy storage system capacity optimization configuration method based on the actual electricity demand of urban rail transit systems and the model of photovoltaic energy storage and generation systems. By establishing a model of photovoltaic power generation system, the photovoltaic power generation capacity is effectively coupled with the electricity consumption of urban rail transit systems. At the same time, a two-level programming model genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimization configuration strategy within the photovoltaic storage power generation system, combining the goal of minimizing the utilization rate of photovoltaic energy and the life cycle cost of the photovoltaic storage power generation system. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can integrate the electricity demand of vehicle depots and elevated stations, as well as the power generation and energy storage resources of the photovoltaic power generation system, significantly improving the photovoltaic utilization rate within the photovoltaic power generation system.

articleTitle: Robust Economic Dispatch of Micro-energy Networks Considering the Uncertainties of Loads and Photovoltaic Output
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: A micro-energy network (MEN) integrates multi-energy systems, multiple loads, and control devices, and helps to achieve the flexibility and economy of various energy networks operation through multi-energy co-generation and co-sourcing. However, the uncertainties of loads and renewable energy generation bring out huge challenges for MENs. This paper establishes a two-stage robust optimal economic dispatch strategy for the MEN under grid-connected and islanded operation modes. The topology of the MEN and the energy flow coupling relations are described based on the energy hub coupling matrix, and the uncertainty sets are presented to characterize the fluctuation of loads and photovoltaic power output. Moreover, the linear decision rules and pairwise theory are applied to the solution of the proposed strategy. The case study validates the effectiveness of the proposed strategy on the modified IEEE test system, which could significantly improve the flexibility, economy, and safety of the MEN.

articleTitle: Analysis of Turn-to-turn Short Circuit Magnetic Field of Dry-type Air-core Reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Reactor is a very important primary high voltage installations in power system, which is mainly used for limiting short circuit current, reactive power compensation, filtering out high-order harmonics and so on. Dry-type Air-core Reactors (DAR) are extensively used in power transmission lines because of their simple structure, low loss, easy installation and maintenance, and many other advantages. They are generally installed outdoors and have a harsh working environment, which is prone to serious accidents such as fire caused by inter-turn short circuit fault. Therefore, it is very important to con-figure a highly sensitive rapid detection system to detect the abnormal state of the reactor and take measures in time. Firstly, the structure of the DAR and the equivalent circuit model (ECM) under normal and interturn short circuit are analyzed. Then the simulation model of the DAR is established by using finite element software, and the change of the whole magnetic field inside the reactor is simulated and analyzed. The simulation results indicate when the reactor is short-circuited between turns, the magnetic field at the fault location will be distorted, and the overall distribution of the magnetic field inside the reactor will change, which will affect the stable operation of the reactor. The change of magnetic field can be used as the criterion to detect whether the reactor fails, so that the reactor can run safely and stably.

articleTitle: A New Integrated Locational Marginal Price Based on the Node Carbon Emission Intensity
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the pressure of energy supply crisis and carbon emission reduction, the main entities in the power market not only need to participate in the carbon market, but also need to carry out a more detailed division of responsibilities for the carbon emissions generated by them. In order to promote a good interaction between the power market and the carbon trading market in China, a new integrated locational marginal price (ILMP) based on the node carbon emission intensity is proposed, which considers the cost of carbon dioxide emitted by power plants in the energy attribute of electricity. According to the PJM-5-node system, the paper has calculated the locational marginal prices (LMP), node carbon emission intensity, carbon emission component and ILMP. The analysis shows that the ILMP appoints the carbon emission cost to the consumers through the price signal, so as to ensure that the incentive compatibility principle of "who generates the cost bears the cost" is satisfied, and the rationality of the mechanism is proved.

articleTitle: Comparison and optimization of an air cooling design for lithium-ion battery packs by using an electrochemical-thermal coupled model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Compared with other ways of heat dissipation, the capability of the air cooling heavily depends on the geometric forms of the cells’ cases, the arrangements of the cells and the boundary conditions, since the air flow is more arbitrary than other phases. A comprehensive study of the relationship between the cooling effect of the air and the factors lacks fairly until now. An electrochemical-thermal coupled model is proposed to design an air cooling system for lithium-ion cells packs in this study. The temperature, pressure and air velocity distributions are simulated, and the thermal and fluid kinetic behaviors in cells or packs are optimized by using the model. Different schemes of geometric forms, air’s velocity and arrangements of cells are compared and analyzed in the process of the heat dissipation. Results show that the uniformity of cell temperature throughout the pack was significantly affected by the geometry of cooling ducts. The capability of the heat dissipation in the battery packs is gradually improved when the inlet velocity increases, conversely, if the velocity exceeds 8 m s-1, the heat dissipation capability is not significantly improved. The heat dissipation capability is better in the staggered arrangement of the cells than in aligned arrangement, and the parallel arrangement of batteries is better than the series-wound arrangement.

articleTitle: Level Approximation Algorithm for RMVSC Based on Double Weighting Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of excessive ripple voltage of traditional low frequency cyclic triggering of RMVSC (Reinjection Multi-level VSC), combining with the voltage characteristics of the converter, based on the idea of MMC (Multi-level Modular Converter) bubble sorting voltage equalization, a new type of RMVSC level approximation algorithm with double weighting factors is constructed, and the model of RMVSC is constructed on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. The simulation results show that the introduction of double weighting factors can optimize the cascaded H-bridge ripple voltage, effectively alleviate the cascaded H-bridge capacitor voltage imbalance, and follow the principle of unnecessary unordered switching action, which significantly reduces the system switching loss. And the dynamic performance is good under STATCOM conditions, and the ideal waveform can be output without filter to realize the soft switching technology.

articleTitle: Haze Removal for UAV Power Line Asset Inspections using Light-weight Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Currently, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are being extensively employed for intelligent power line asset inspections. However, the visual quality of the captured video images by UAVs suffers a detrimental impact in hazy weather conditions, leading to a degradation in the accuracy of identifying equipment defects in power lines. Over the past years, researchers have proposed several methods to mitigate the adverse effects of haze on images. Nevertheless, these approaches often necessitate a considerable number of parameters and exhibit low efficiency, thereby posing challenges in meeting the real-time requirements of automatic UAV inspections. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a novel computationally efficient light-weight image dehazing network (LID-Net) specifically tailored for power-constrained scenarios, such as UAV inspections. LID-Net incorporates an encoder-decoder structure with improved depthwise separable convolutions as its basic building blocks. Moreover, it leverages a re-constructed atmospheric scattering model to jointly estimate the global information. Additionally, a dehazing benchmark specifically synthesized for power line asset inspections, named PLAI-HAZE, is proposed. Extensive experiments are conducted using hazy images, followed by quantitative and qualitative evaluations to confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Condition Partition and Recognition of SOFC System Based on Fusion Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The running state of the SOFC system determines whether it can provide normal power for other equipment. If there is a fault and can not be found in time, the fault will quickly spread to other components and make the system run abnormally. To accurately grasp the type of operating conditions is the key to ensure that the SOFC system is in a normal working state.
